title: Why Do We Sneeze? The 100 MPH Nose Cleaner!

lines.text: Tickle, tickle in your nose! Your eyes squeeze shut, you take a sharp breath, and...
lines.caps: Tickle, tickle in your *NOSE! | Your eyes squeeze shut, and *THEN...

lines.text: ACHOOO! A giant explosive sneeze blasts out into your elbow tissue!
lines.caps: *ACHOOO! A giant explosive *SNEEZE | blasts out into your *ELBOW!

lines.text: Did you know a sneeze can launch droplets at up to one hundred miles per hour?
lines.caps: A sneeze can launch air at up to *ONE HUNDRED | miles per *HOUR!

lines.text: Your nose is lined with millions of microscopic cilia hairs acting as security guards!
lines.caps: Your nose is lined with *CILIA | hairs acting as security *GUARDS!

lines.text: When dust, pollen, or pepper touches the trigeminal nerve inside your nasal lining...
lines.caps: When dust or pollen touches the *NERVE | inside your nasal *LINING...

lines.text: A red alert flashes to the sneeze center in your lower brainstem!
lines.caps: A red alert *FLASHES | to the sneeze center in your *BRAIN!

lines.text: Your chest muscles tighten, vocal cords snap shut, and air pressure builds like a cannon!
lines.caps: Your chest *TIGHTENS, | building air pressure like a *CANNON!

lines.text: POW! It ejects unwanted germs and dust so your airways stay clean and safe!
lines.caps: *POW! It ejects unwanted *GERMS | so your airways stay clean and *SAFE!
